entities.text: Crowd: 50 agents walk this hall round 30 pillars, each planning routes over the walk area and pushing off its neighbours every tick. Loads the game's own code; the scene setting crowd sets how many.
Pile: 504 props of four shapes fall through pegs and a funnel into one heap. Loads the rigid-body solver and the pose sync of every dynamic body.
Movers: 90 followers on ping-pong and loop paths, each carrying an attached lip and a loose rider. Loads path following, attachments and kinematic contacts.
Movers: 90 followers on ping-pong and loop paths, each carrying an attached lip and a loose rider. Loads path following, attachments and kinematic contacts.
Field: 96 bouncy balls cross 126 overlapping sensors and 5 more riding the pistons; a zigzag floor keeps them moving. Loads overlap tracking and sensor events.

Wall: 1440 sprites with no bodies. The first third of the rows share one atlas (best case for batching), the second alternates textures, the last alternates blend, tint, alpha and z (worst case). 48 translucent washes add overdraw; 96 fades are destroyed over the first 25 s.
Rooms: 18 room instances, each nesting a doorway and two latches, half of them mirrored, with posts, turned gates and variants between. Loads prefab expansion, nested followers and transforms.
Rooms: 18 room instances, each nesting a doorway and two latches, half of them mirrored, with posts, turned gates and variants between. Loads prefab expansion, nested followers and transforms.

Churn: 4 spawners each emit 60 pellets a second that live 4 s, at most 240 at once, onto pegs and two slopes. Loads spawning, destroying and the game's bookkeeping; the scene settings spawnRate and spawnCap scale it.

Terrain: 234 CCD props rain onto 90 turned boxes, triangles, capsules and circles and a 117-point chain. A comb-shaped walk area with 24 holes sits over it. Loads static colliders, CCD and the nav mesh.
